e.title: projectionmodels
e.summary: 投影模型（OpenActuarial，PyPI）：续保期内的保费/理赔/费用投影
e.body: projectionmodels（OpenActuarial 生态，PyPI）做投影建模：续保周期内的保费、理赔、费用投影——业务投影的现代工具。对 RIAA：业务投影的实现——[[heavylight]]/[[lifelib]]（现金流建模）的投影方法对照；理解「续保周期内的业务演化」建模（保单留存/续保率/新业务）；财务预测/预算场景（[[rim524]] 会计与财务）的工具；OpenActuarial 生态的投影模块。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：OpenActuarial 仓库 + PyPI 徽章确认（保费/理赔/费用投影），未实测
e.summary_en: Projection models (OpenActuarial, PyPI): premium/claims/expense projection over the renewal horizon
e.summary_hk: 投影模型（OpenActuarial，PyPI）：續保期內的保費/理賠/費用投影
e.body_en: projectionmodels (OpenActuarial ecosystem, PyPI) does projection modelling: premium, claims and expense projections over the renewal horizon — a modern tool of business projection. For RIAA: an implementation of business projection — contrasting the projection methods of [[heavylight]]/[[lifelib]] (cashflow modelling); understand business-evolution modelling over renewal cycles (policy retention/renewal rates/new business); a tool of financial forecasting/budgeting scenarios ([[rim524]] accounting & financial management); the projection module of the OpenActuarial ecosystem.
e.body_hk: projectionmodels（OpenActuarial 生態，PyPI）做投影建模：續保周期內的保費、理賠、費用投影——業務投影的現代工具。對 RIAA：業務投影的實現——[[heavylight]]/[[lifelib]]（現金流建模）的投影方法對照；理解「續保周期內的業務演化」建模（保單留存/續保率/新業務）；財務預測/預算場景（[[rim524]] 會計與財務）的工具；OpenActuarial 生態的投影模塊。
